meta.title: Register-data tables
meta.tagline: Every regression table of an empirical paper, one entry per estimated column, transcribed cell by cell with the specification needed to re-run it.
meta.description: One entry per regression column (a (panel, column) pair of a table that reports estimated coefficients): outcome, target regressor, the full specification (controls itemised, fixed effects, instruments, weights, clustering, sample restrictions) and every printed cell with its row type. Written for the danish-register-econ reproduction pipeline; the companion of the Register-data claims preset, whose point estimates Metalens cross-checks against these cells.

entries.label: Regression column
entries.help: one estimated column of a table that reports regression coefficients; a table with panels that each report their own regressions gives one entry per (panel, column) pair. Summary-statistics, correlation and variable-definition tables are not entries
entries.title: {table_number} {panel} col {column}

fields.name: regression_id
fields.label: Regression id
fields.help: exactly T<table>::<panel>::C<column>: the table number, the panel letter or _ when there are no panels, the column label with punctuation stripped — Table 3 column (2) without panels is T3::_::C2, Table A1 panel B column (1) is TA1::B::C1

fields.name: column
fields.label: Column
fields.help: the column label exactly as printed: '(2)', 'Percent'

fields.name: column_label
fields.label: Column heading
fields.help: the heading above the column when there is one beyond the number ('Log earnings', 'Women')

fields.name: outcome_variable
fields.label: Outcome
fields.help: the dependent variable of this column as the paper names it

fields.name: target_regressors
fields.label: Target regressors
fields.help: the row label(s), as printed, of the coefficient(s) the column is ABOUT — the treatment, the instrumented regressor, the policy variable; several only when the claim rests on them jointly; empty when the column has no focal coefficient (balance table, pure first stage) — say so in notes

fields.name: model_type
fields.label: Model
fields.help: the estimator as the paper states it; unknown when it does not say

fields.name: controls
fields.label: Controls
fields.help: every control individually ('age', 'age squared', 'years of schooling'), never 'demographic controls'; dereference 'as in Table 3' and footnotes

fields.name: iv
fields.label: Instruments
fields.help: the endogenous variable and its instruments; null when not an IV column

fields.name: cluster_level
fields.label: Clustering
fields.help: the level standard errors are clustered at; null when not clustered or not stated

fields.name: sample_restrictions
fields.label: Sample
fields.help: operational: the rule and the resulting N where the paper states it ('workers employed in textile manufacturing firms in 1999; N = 12,410'), not 'the estimation sample'

fields.name: outcome_construction
fields.label: Outcome construction
fields.help: how the outcome is built from the registers ('log of annual labour income from the IND register, deflated to 2015 prices')

fields.name: data_construction_steps
fields.label: Data construction
fields.help: the steps someone with the data would take to build the estimation sample

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.help: anything else about this column: parenthesised values are t-statistics, the focal regressor could not be told, …

fields.name: cells
fields.label: Cells
fields.help: every value printed in the column, top to bottom, including controls, the constant and the statistics rows; nothing skipped, reordered, rounded or added

columns.name: row_index
columns.label: Row index
columns.help: 0-based position down the column counting every printed row (standard-error and statistics rows included)

columns.name: raw_text
columns.label: As printed
columns.help: the cell verbatim, stars and parentheses included: '0.94***', '(0.31)', 'Yes'

columns.name: numeric_value
columns.label: Value
columns.help: the number with stars, parentheses, commas and % stripped, sign and every printed digit preserved; null for non-numeric cells

columns.name: row_type
columns.label: Row type
columns.help: read the table notes first: parenthesised values are standard errors in most papers but t-statistics or p-values in some

columns.name: refers_to
columns.label: Refers to
columns.help: on an se / t_stat / p_value / ci row: the row_index of the coefficient it belongs to; null on coefficient rows

groups.label: Specification
groups.help: outcome, target regressor, model, controls, sample

groups.label: Cells
groups.help: every printed value transcribed with the right row type and the right coefficient link
